description: This file defines the PduParser class for parsing MMS (Multimedia Messaging Service) PDUs in an Android application. It includes methods for parsing headers, parts, and various data types within a WAP/WSP encoded message, supporting operations like extracting content-type, message headers, and message body parts.

classes.name: PduParser
classes.description: Main class for parsing MMS PDU byte streams, extracting headers, body parts, and interpreting WAP/WSP data formats.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Main method to parse the PDU data stream into a structured message object (e.g., SendReq, NotificationInd, etc.).

methods.name: parseHeaders
methods.description: Parses the PDU headers from the data stream into a PduHeaders object.

methods.name: parseParts
methods.description: Parses the message parts (body) from the data stream into a PduBody object.

methods.name: parseContentType
methods.description: Parses the Content-Type header value and its parameters from the data stream.

methods.name: parseWapString
methods.description: Parses a WAP/WSP encoded string (Text-String, Quoted-String, or Token) from the input stream.

methods.name: parseEncodedStringValue
methods.description: Parses an encoded string value, potentially with charset, from the data stream.

methods.name: parseLongInteger
methods.description: Parses a long integer value encoded with WAP/WSP encoding rules.

methods.name: parseIntegerValue
methods.description: Parses an integer value that can be represented as short or long integer.

methods.name: parseShortInteger
methods.description: Parses an 8-bit short integer value from the data stream.

methods.name: extractByteValue
methods.description: Reads a single byte value from the input stream.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Internal method for logging debug information.
